public_rationale: Compared with the January 2023 agreement's exclusive Azure provision, the October 28, 2025 terms reduced exclusivity by allowing non-API products on other clouds and removing Microsoft's compute right of first refusal [e1, e2]. But the same agreement extended Microsoft's model and product IP rights through 2032 and added a $250 billion Azure purchase commitment [e3]. These changes within the October–December 2025 assessment period support reduced exclusivity, while the stronger continuing commitments count against an unqualified claim that the relationship weakened [e2, e3].
limitations: Public contractual terms do not establish private trust or personal relations.
The evidence supplies no common measure for weighing reduced exclusivity against stronger continuing commitments.
